newsHighlights.title: AllianzGI sees growing A-share appeal
newsHighlights.summary: German asset manager AllianzGI says foreign investors are showing growing interest in Chinese A-shares as market sentiment improves.
newsHighlights.translation: 德国资产管理公司安联投资表示，随着市场情绪改善，外国投资者对中国A股的兴趣日益增长。

newsHighlights.title: Step into the wonderful world of the CIIE
newsHighlights.summary: The China International Import Expo serves as a launchpad for cutting-edge technologies and a debut platform for new global exhibitors.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国国际进口博览会不仅是进口商品的展会，更是前沿技术的起跳板和全球新展商的首秀平台。

newsHighlights.title: China's win-win philosophy is an ancient idea
newsHighlights.summary: China's win-win approach to international relations traces back to an ancient reminder: when you reap fruits, remember the tree.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国在国际关系中秉持的双赢理念源远流长，古语有云：饮水思源，得鱼忘筌不可取。

newsHighlights.title: Democrats projected to win US Congress in midterm elections
newsHighlights.summary: US Democrats are projected to win control of Congress in the 2026 midterm elections, a result with major implications for markets and trade policy.
newsHighlights.translation: 美国民主党预计赢得2026年中期选举并掌控国会，这一结果对市场和贸易政策影响重大。

newsHighlights.title: US-Iran tensions persist amid US midterms, regional mediation
newsHighlights.summary: Tensions between the US and Iran continue even as regional mediation efforts try to ease the standoff.
newsHighlights.translation: 尽管地区斡旋努力缓解僵局，美伊之间的紧张局势仍在持续。

quote.quote: Price is what you pay; value is what you get.
quote.author: Warren Buffett
quote.translation: 价格是你付出的，价值才是你得到的。
quote.explanation: 这句话提醒投资者：买入资产时关注的不应只是市场价格，而是资产本身的长期价值。正如今日新闻中安联投资看好A股，看的是中国经济与企业盈利的长期基本面，而非短期价格波动。

vocabulary.example: AllianzGI sees a growing appeal of Chinese A-shares among global investors.
vocabulary.translation: 安联投资认为，中国A股对全球投资者的吸引力正在增强。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自标题 AllianzGI sees growing A-share appeal，appeal 在此表示“吸引力”。

vocabulary.definition: 起跳板；（事业发展的）起点、平台
vocabulary.example: The CIIE has become a launchpad for cutting-edge technologies from global firms.
vocabulary.translation: 进博会已成为全球企业前沿技术的起跳板。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻摘要："it's also a launchpad for cutting-edge technologies from global firms"。

vocabulary.example: Startups use the expo to showcase their cutting-edge products to Chinese buyers.
vocabulary.translation: 初创企业借助展会向中国买家展示其最前沿的产品。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻摘要："a launchpad for cutting-edge technologies"。

vocabulary.example: Thousands of exhibitors from around the world gather in Shanghai for the CIIE.
vocabulary.translation: 成千上万来自世界各地的参展商齐聚上海参加进博会。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻摘要："a debut platform for new exhibitors"。

vocabulary.example: Several foreign brands chose the CIIE for their China debut.
vocabulary.translation: 多个外国品牌选择在进博会完成其在中国的首次亮相。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻摘要："a debut platform for new exhibitors stepping into..."。

vocabulary.example: Firms that invest early in China reap the fruits of long-term growth.
vocabulary.translation: 较早在中国投资的企业收获了长期增长的成果。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻引用的古语："When you reap fruits, you remember the tree"。

vocabulary.definition: 股票；股权（常用复数 equities）
vocabulary.example: Foreign funds have increased their allocation to Chinese equity markets.
vocabulary.translation: 外国基金加大了对中国股票市场的配置。
vocabulary.newsContext: 与新闻 AllianzGI sees growing A-share appeal 相关，A-share 指中国 A 股股票市场（equity market）。

vocabulary.example: Market sentiment improved after the release of strong economic data.
vocabulary.translation: 强劲经济数据发布后，市场情绪有所改善。
vocabulary.newsContext: 与新闻 AllianzGI sees growing A-share appeal 相关，market sentiment 是金融新闻高频搭配。

vocabulary.example: The projection of a Democratic victory sent shockwaves through global markets.
vocabulary.translation: 民主党获胜的预测在全球市场引起震动。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻："Democrats projected to win US Congress in midterm elections"，projected 是其动词形式。

vocabulary.example: Geopolitical tension often drives investors toward safer assets.
vocabulary.translation: 地缘政治紧张局势常促使投资者转向避险资产。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻："US-Iran tensions persist amid US midterms, regional mediation"。

pattern.pattern: A is far more than (a) ..., it's also ..., and a ... （A 远不止是……，它还是……，以及……）
pattern.example: The China International Import Expo is far more than an expo for imported goods, it's also a launchpad for cutting-edge technologies from global firms, and a debut platform for new exhibitors.
pattern.translation: 中国国际进口博览会远不止是一个进口商品展会，它还是全球企业前沿技术的起跳板，以及新展商的首秀平台。
pattern.usage: 用于强调某事物的多重价值和意义，语气比 not only...but also 更有表现力。写作或演讲中常用来升华主题，例如：This policy is far more than a stimulus package; it is also a signal of confidence to global investors.

grammar.title: 新闻标题中的省略与过去分词作后置定语（be projected to do）
grammar.explanation: 英文新闻标题常省略 be 动词，用过去分词直接作表语或定语，以求简洁。"Democrats projected to win US Congress" 实际是 "Democrats are projected to win US Congress"。be projected to do 表示“预计会……”，常用于经济与政治预测；同类结构还有 be expected to、be estimated to、be scheduled to。
examples: Democrats projected to win US Congress in midterm elections.
China's GDP is projected to grow steadily over the next five years.

pronunciation.tips: 重音落在第二音节 -hi-：/ɪɡ-ˈzɪ-bɪ-tə/。词首 ex- 在此发 /ɪɡ/（受后接浊辅音 /z/ 影响），不要读成 /eks/。中间音节 /zɪb/ 短促清晰，结尾 -tor 弱读为 /tə/。同类词：exhibition /ˌeksɪˈbɪʃn/（重音在第三音节），注意两者重音位置不同。
examples: Over 3,000 exhibitors attended the China International Import Expo.
Each exhibitor prepared a debut product for the Chinese market.

reading.title: China's Markets and the CIIE Keep Drawing Global Business
reading.content: The China International Import Expo has grown into far more than a trade fair for imported goods. For global companies, it is a launchpad for cutting-edge technologies, a debut platform for new exhibitors, and a gateway to one of the world's largest consumer markets. Financial firms are watching closely as well. AllianzGI, the German asset manager, says the appeal of Chinese A-shares is growing as market sentiment improves and corporate earnings recover. In a year marked by geopolitical tension — from the US midterms to US-Iran standoffs — China's long-standing win-win philosophy offers a familiar reminder: when you reap fruits, remember the tree. That spirit of mutual benefit runs through both the expo floor and the capital markets. For international businesses and investors, the message of 2026 is clear: engagement, not isolation, remains the most profitable strategy.
reading.translation: 中国国际进口博览会早已不只是一个进口商品交易会。对全球企业而言，它是前沿技术的起跳板，是新展商的首秀平台，也是通往全球最大消费市场之一的门户。金融机构同样密切关注。德国资产管理公司安联投资表示，随着市场情绪改善、企业盈利回升，中国A股的吸引力不断增强。在这样一个地缘政治紧张的一年——从美国中期选举到美伊僵局——中国一贯秉持的双赢理念给出了一句熟悉的提醒：饮水思源。这种互利共赢的精神既体现在进博会的展台上，也体现在资本市场上。对国际企业和投资者而言，2026年的信号很明确：参与而非孤立，才是最有利可图的策略。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 ChinaDaily《Step into the wonderful world of the CIIE》《AllianzGI sees growing A-share appeal》《China's win-win philosophy is an ancient idea》及 CGTN《Democrats projected to win US Congress in midterm elections》《US-Iran tensions persist》改写整合，专为英语学习设计。
